intent.appetite: One Developer conversation, one Build, two outer resumptions. Factor existing guidance, apply the accepted six-profile table, and verify plumbing plus real lifecycle/native dispatch.
non_goals: Python editing preferences, hook parsing changes, bytecode or Finder ignore hygiene.
File-discovered role context, tracking projection, evidence-retention machinery or handoff redesign.
Shaping-quality changes or the five-case Shaping evaluation.
Suite parallelization, test-runner optimization, benchmarks, model ranking or savings claims.
New model providers, commands, routing configuration schema, fallback models, adaptive routing, mandatory production fanout or automatic escalation.
Changing gate ownership, Developer continuity, Review independence, Candidate protection, output schemas, retry limits, recovery or compaction policy.
Importing or accepting the original combined dirty Candidate.
intent.outcome: Each role receives one consistent execution/delegation policy and the configured profiles, preserving role authority and existing Build lifecycle.
intent.problem: Root/helper profile choices and delegation guidance are duplicated across role renderers; current tracked defaults do not implement the previously accepted role table.
intent.title: Configure role models and unify delegation guidance

purpose: inspection evidence; not a recovery checkpoint

risks.description: Shared factoring can erase role restrictions. Keep human Shaping decisions/approval, Developer gate restrictions, read-only Review/children, current output schemas and independent root judgment intact. Do not import unrelated combined-policy obligations.

Historical small experiments support reversible profile choices only. Scout facts passed while exact citations and one read-only boundary failed; keep qualifications and corrections. Validate current native identity from runner metadata rather than self-report. Include whole-task work before making performance comparisons; this Intent promises no savings.
Ordinary carryover lifecycle rules approved with this package. No installer, protected-seed transition, runtime migration or new persistent evidence service.

ownership.git_state: Maintained sources are tracked in the Build commit; this Draft remains ignored until normal approval and completion flow.
ownership.owner_after_creation: Repository maintainers own new policy, renderer and test sources immediately.
ownership.owner_during_operation: Maintainers retain ownership; runtime reads maintained sources without rewriting them.
ownership.paths: .kogen/config.yaml, priv/kogen/prompts sources, scoped renderers/parser, test sources and README.md
ownership.permitted_mutation: Reviewed Git edits within approved guarded paths; no runtime self-modification or automatic profile substitution.
ownership.upgrade_behavior: Ordinary reviewed Git changes update canonical source and tests; no migration service or ownership transition.
ownership.validation: check validates public rendering, config, error paths and receipt controls; live proves native dispatch and existing lifecycle; independent Review assesses authority.
ownership.when_exists: Inspect and edit maintained source in place, reconcile one shared owner, and preserve unrelated work.

ownership.git_state: Test sources are tracked; raw account rollouts and disposable repositories remain ignored runtime data. Curated evidence follows existing Complete rules.
ownership.owner_after_creation: The test runner owns its new disposable fixture, processes and receipts immediately.
ownership.owner_during_operation: Runner controls only its own fixture and descendants; repository maintainers own maintained test inputs.
ownership.paths: Existing live runner private fixtures extended for native dispatch, their generated native receipts and owned processes
ownership.permitted_mutation: Create/update private fixture files, capture native evidence and clean only owned data/processes using existing live runner conventions; read-only probe children preserve fixture inputs.
ownership.upgrade_behavior: Reviewed test updates; fresh runs recreate transient fixtures, preserve earlier evidence and add no replay/retry service.
ownership.validation: Offline missing/mismatched/unrelated/incomplete receipt controls and current live profile/session/fact assertions; preserve existing cleanup checks.
ownership.when_exists: Preserve maintained fixture inputs and earlier runs; use unique private runs without overwriting existing evidence.

risks.description: Selected reports/receipts are copied evidence with original source hashes, not current acceptance. Preserve historical failures, qualifications and private archive locators.

ownership.git_state: Concise curated copies accompany eventual Complete publication. Raw native account payloads and private archives remain ignored outside this package.
ownership.owner_after_creation: Maintainers retain evidence copied under the human authorization; original evidence ownership is unchanged.
ownership.owner_during_operation: Reports and receipts are historical inputs. Controller and Reviewer inspect relevant evidence without automatically replaying campaigns.
ownership.paths: This Intent evidence/historical copies, source-manifest.json, recheck.json and evidence index; original combined Draft/private archives
ownership.permitted_mutation: Append corrections/provenance and update the index while drafting; preserve copied original bytes and leave originals/private archives untouched.
ownership.upgrade_behavior: Historical evidence does not upgrade or rerun; later observations retain original dates/outcomes and cannot replace the current Build-owned gates.
ownership.validation: Source/copy SHA-256 equality, preserved V7 raw-postflight hash, document/YAML/link checks and independent assessment of limitations.
ownership.when_exists: Do not overwrite original evidence or earlier archives; verify selected source/destination bytes. A conflicting new Draft path requires inspection rather than replacement.

scenarios.evidence: Public Shape fresh/continuation captures and fake Build Developer/Reviewer captures, including duplicate/missing policy and unresolved-placeholder assertions; independent semantic inspection of full emitted prompts.
scenarios.given: Fresh Shape, continued Shape, Developer and Reviewer use the maintained prompt sources.
scenarios.then: Exactly one expanded shared execution/delegation policy appears in each initial prompt, with no unresolved placeholders or superseded routing copies. Configured profile rendering has one maintained owner. Role-specific permissions, gate instructions and output contracts remain authoritative.
scenarios.when: Their public launch routes render instructions.
scenarios.wrong_result: Only a helper renderer is tested, one public route retains old routing, or shared prose grants Reviewer helpers write authority.

scenarios.evidence: Public fake-harness argv and complete prompt captures with deliberately distinct fixture profiles across all routes; invalid/missing/blank required configuration fails before dispatch. Update old default assertions in intent_test.exs and lifecycle_test.exs to the selected table while retaining distinct non-default coverage.
scenarios.given: The selected table in intent.yaml is installed, or a fixture configures distinct non-default values for all six profiles.
scenarios.then: Tracked defaults match the selected table. Root CLI arguments and displayed configured root/helper model and effort values match current configuration without hardcoding or inheritance. Continuation preserves original shaping metadata and records the current visit separately. Helper labels map to supported native kinds: scout explorer, worker worker, expert default, always with explicit model/effort.
scenarios.when: Kogen starts fresh/continued Shape, launches/resumes Developer and launches each fresh Reviewer.
scenarios.wrong_result: It renders new text while root CLI uses old defaults, resumes with another model, rewrites original provenance, or passes scout/expert as native agent-kind enums.

scenarios.evidence: Cross-role rendering regressions plus independent inspection of packet/authority instructions; historical local/delegated comparison remains explicitly workload-specific.
scenarios.given: A role has both short coupled work and potentially worthwhile independent work.
scenarios.then: policy.md obligations are present: complete-task accounting, small sufficient packets, appropriate local work and helper reuse, useful concurrency, explicit ownership and stopping conditions, concise cited advisory returns, targeted contradiction checks, and root responsibility. No production spawn quota, mandatory fanout or automatic escalation is introduced.
scenarios.when: The role reads shared guidance and delegates when justified.
scenarios.wrong_result: A nominally faster policy creates a child for every command, repeats bulk investigation, substitutes helper judgment for root authority, or equates token price with complete-task savings.

scenarios.evidence: Fake executable exercises actual launch_reviewer boundary for nonzero exit, provider-error event, incomplete turn and completed malformed verdict; assert preserved existing parser error and no second substituted invocation. No live unavailable-model campaign.
scenarios.given: Required configuration is invalid, or the provider rejects/fails a requested profile.
scenarios.then: Invalid required configuration prevents launch. Provider execution errors remain visible as execution errors with their original available diagnostic, with no profile fallback or hidden rerun. In particular Reviewer execution failure is not rewritten into a malformed completed verdict; a completed invalid verdict still takes the existing malformed-verdict path. Helpers are instructed to report native unavailability rather than substitute or infer identity from self-report.
scenarios.when: Configuration parsing or actual harness response handling runs.
scenarios.wrong_result: An unavailable Reviewer is reported only as malformed JSON, a missing helper inherits root settings, or a completed malformed verdict is accepted as transport success.

scenarios.evidence: Focused existing live-test infrastructure extended with one compact three-profile routing fixture, not a quality evaluation suite. Offline receipt controls reject missing, wrong-profile, unrelated-child and incomplete native records; live captures actual native child execution. Historical V7/helper results establish feasibility only.
scenarios.given: The configured helper profiles and shared policy are rendered through a production role renderer into an isolated live fixture.
scenarios.then: All three children use explicit configured model/effort and supported kinds, return the expected task-specific facts, and preserve assigned read-only fixture boundaries. Runner-owned native metadata ties each child to the parent and confirms actual profile and completion; missing or contradictory evidence fails. The fixture may require dispatch to test routing; general product policy remains selective.
scenarios.when: One compact test-only native dispatch probe runs bounded scout, worker and expert tasks against deterministic fixture facts.
scenarios.wrong_result: The probe passes from prompt strings or a helper saying its own model name, uses invented native kinds, or silently accepts absent/mismatched child evidence.

scenarios.evidence: Retain existing real public lifecycle tests and correlate launch/resume/review profile/session evidence; fake lifecycle guards route and negative controls. Repair the existing semantic fixture to enforce exact argument count and reject generic extra/missing arguments and invalid role/model/effort; preserve independent bad/good Reviewer judgments and the original contract. No timing threshold, repeated benchmark campaign or new evaluation framework.
scenarios.given: Selected profiles and shared policy are applied to the existing live public Shape/Build fixtures.
scenarios.then: The fixture reaches accepted publication with exact Developer continuity, fresh independent Review, unchanged Candidate/gate/output contracts and two outer resumptions. Current native root routing matches configured profiles. Prior evidence is not substituted for the new Build-owned live receipt.
scenarios.when: The existing live lifecycle performs fresh Shape, continued Shape, approved fixture Build, failed Stop correction and Reviewer-directed rework.
scenarios.wrong_result: Primitive provider calls pass but public lifecycle output is unusable, a fresh Developer replaces resume, gates are weakened, or an old V7 receipt is called current acceptance.
